cikey.text: The CI watch workflow holds an open al-watch key for <src> (key <KEY>): run that source's check on the dev host, act on the finding, then move its pin or its tools/watch_ci.py baseline. ACCEPT: the key issue closes on the next watch workflow run. ZERO-CLICK: the daily workflow watches while the dev host is off. SOURCE: watch ci <src> <KEY>, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.
